title: Compatible affine exterior-to-self-Tor comparisons
statement: Let i:Z \to Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] and n a natural number. Put E=\Lambda^n(i^*ker(i)) [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-pc-module-pullback], B=i_*O_Z and Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0] \otimes^{L} B[0]) in the fixed derived category [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For affine U in Y, let O_U=i^{-1}U and let T_U sheafify an A=Gamma(Y,U)-module on U, extend it to Y and tensor-pull it back to Z. Let c_U be the normalized exterior-conormal-to-Tor comparison for I=i.ker.ideal U [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. There is a family of local morphisms phi_U:E|_{O_U} \to Q|_{O_U}. Each admits coordinate isomorphisms s_U:E|_{O_U} \cong T_U(source(c_U))|_{O_U} and t_U:T_U(target(c_U))|_{O_U} \cong Q|_{O_U} such that phi_U=s_U followed by T_U(c_U)|_{O_U} followed by t_U. For every open W of Z and arrows W \to O_U and W \to O_{U'}, the components of phi_U and phi_{U'} on W are equal. No global morphism, dual square, or regularity is asserted.

proof.text: On each affine closed chart, identify the structure-sheaf quotient and sheafify a projective quotient resolution. Tensoring that resolution with the quotient computes the restriction of the fixed K-flat derived self tensor. Since the resulting homology is annihilated by the immersion ideal, ordinary tensor pullback gives its unchanged quotient-module sheaf. This supplies the target coordinate isomorphism.

The inverse-image chart is affine and the quotient map on sections is surjective. Apply the actual kernel conormal sections theorem with identity ring coordinates. The canonical ideal-module kernel agrees with the sheaf module kernel, so this is the conormal used by E. Associated sheaves commute with exterior powers and localization; this supplies the source coordinate isomorphism.

Conjugate the sheafified normalized algebraic map by these two coordinate isomorphisms to define a local phi_U. Under localization the quotient resolution and conormal unit agree with those on a smaller basic open. Tor products and the Koszul normalization localize. Resolution-independent uniqueness of the normalized comparison therefore makes the local maps equal on basic-open overlaps. Such opens cover each overlap; separatedness extends equality to every component W.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_compatible_affine_selfTor_maps
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n
    ∃ φ : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⟶ Q.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      (∀ U, IsAffineSelfTorChartMap i U n E Q (φ U)) ∧
      ∀ (U U' : Y.affineOpens) (W : Z.Opens)
        (a : W ⟶ i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) (b : W ⟶ i ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1),
        (φ U).val.app (op (Over.mk a)) =
          (φ U').val.app (op (Over.mk b))
